from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["Music is a journey through time.", "The beat is our basic unit.", "Like a clock, it ticks steady."]
        self.setup_layout("The Concept of Pulse", lecture_lines)
        
        timeline = Line(start=self.grid["D1"], end=self.grid["D6"], color=WHITE)
        self.add(timeline)
        
        pulses = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.15, color="#808080") for _ in range(6)])
        for i, dot in enumerate(pulses):
            dot.move_to(self.grid[f"D{i+1}"])
        self.add(pulses)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        self.play(FadeIn(pulses))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        for dot in pulses:
            self.play(dot.animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"), run_time=0.2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00CED1"))
        pulse_anim = AnimationGroup(*[
            Indicate(dot, color="#FF4500", scale_factor=1.5) for dot in pulses
        ], lag_ratio=0.3)
        self.play(pulse_anim)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["We organize beats into measures.", "Time signatures define these boxes.", "Four beats fit in one measure."]
        self.setup_layout("Introduction to Measure (Bars)", lecture_lines)
        
        # Create elements
        bar_line1 = Line(UP, DOWN, color=WHITE).set_length(3)
        bar_line2 = Line(UP, DOWN, color=WHITE).set_length(3)
        beats = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.3, color="#00FF7F", fill_opacity=0.5) for _ in range(4)])
        measure_box = VGroup(bar_line1, bar_line2, beats).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5)
        
        # Position elements
        self.place_in_area(measure_box, 'B2', 'E5', scale_factor=0.8)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Create(bar_line1))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        for beat in beats:
            self.play(FadeIn(beat, scale=0.5), run_time=0.3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Create(bar_line2))
        self.wait(1)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["Notes are just musical fractions.", "A whole note is one.", "Four quarters make a whole."]
        self.setup_layout("The Math of Note Values (Fractions)", lecture_lines)
        
        # Assets
        whole_circle = Circle(radius=1.5, color="#FF6347", fill_opacity=0.5)
        label_whole = Text("1", font_size=40).move_to(whole_circle.get_center())
        whole_note = VGroup(whole_circle, label_whole)

        half1 = Sector(radius=1.5, start_angle=PI/2, angle=PI, color="#1E90FF", fill_opacity=0.5)
        half2 = Sector(radius=1.5, start_angle=3*PI/2, angle=PI, color="#1E90FF", fill_opacity=0.5)
        
        q1 = Sector(radius=1.2, start_angle=0, angle=PI/2, color="#FFFF00", fill_opacity=0.5)
        q2 = Sector(radius=1.2, start_angle=PI/2, angle=PI/2, color="#FFFF00", fill_opacity=0.5)
        q3 = Sector(radius=1.2, start_angle=PI, angle=PI/2, color="#FFFF00", fill_opacity=0.5)
        q4 = Sector(radius=1.2, start_angle=3*PI/2, angle=PI/2, color="#FFFF00", fill_opacity=0.5)
        quarters = VGroup(q1, q2, q3, q4).arrange_in_grid(2, 2, buff=0.1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FF6347"))
        self.place_at_grid(whole_note, "C3", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(whole_note))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#1E90FF"))
        self.play(FadeOut(whole_note))
        self.place_at_grid(half1, "C2", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(half2, "C4", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(half1), FadeIn(half2))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FFFF00"))
        self.play(FadeOut(half1), FadeOut(half2))
        self.place_at_grid(quarters, "C3", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(quarters))
        self.wait(2)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Application: Composing with Constraints", [
            "Let's fill our measure box.",
            "Different notes add up perfectly.",
            "Math keeps the rhythm steady."
        ])
        
        time_sig = Text("4/4", font_size=48, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(time_sig, 'B2')
        
        notes = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.3, fill_opacity=1, color="#00BFFF") for _ in range(4)])
        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
            self.place_at_grid(note, f'C{i+2}')

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"), Write(time_sig))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00BFFF"), Create(notes))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FF00FF"), notes.animate.set_color("#FF00FF"))
        self.wait(1)

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Summary & The Universal Language", [
            "Music is just applied math.", 
            "Measures help us organize patterns.", 
            "Rhythm is counting in disguise."
        ])
        
        # Elements
        pulse = Circle(radius=0.5, color=WHITE)
        rhythmic_structures = VGroup(*[
            Square(side_length=0.3, color="#7FFF00", fill_opacity=0.5).shift(i*0.5*RIGHT) 
            for i in range(5)
        ])
        glow = Circle(radius=1.5, color="#8A2BE2", fill_opacity=0.2, stroke_width=0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(pulse), ChangeDecimalToColor(self.lecture[0], "#FFFFFF"))
        self.place_at_grid(pulse, "C3")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(Create(rhythmic_structures), ChangeDecimalToColor(self.lecture[1], "#7FFF00"))
        self.place_in_area(rhythmic_structures, "B4", "D6")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(glow), ChangeDecimalToColor(self.lecture[2], "#8A2BE2"))
        self.place_at_grid(glow, "C3")
        self.play(FadeOut(pulse), FadeOut(rhythmic_structures), FadeOut(glow))

class ChangeDecimalToColor(Animation):
    def __init__(self, mobject, color, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(mobject, **kwargs)
        self.color = color
    def interpolate_mobject(self, alpha):
        self.mobject.set_color(self.color)

outline.topic: The Rhythm of Mathematics: Understanding Music and Measure Theory
outline.target_audience: Middle school students with an interest in music and basic arithmetic

sections.title: The Concept of Pulse: Beats as Units of Time
sections.content: Establish the foundation of music as a time-based structure. Introduce the 'Beat' as the fundamental unit of measurement, similar to the ticking of a clock.
sections.example: A woodpecker drumming on a tree: each peck is a pulse. Visually represent this as a series of equidistant dots on a timeline.

sections.title: Introduction to Measure (Bars)
sections.content: Explain that music is organized into 'Measures' (or bars) to make it readable. Introduce the Time Signature as a mathematical fraction: Top number (beats per measure) over bottom number (the note type getting one beat).
sections.example: A '4/4' time signature visualized as a box containing 4 quarter-note symbols. Think of it like a container that can only hold exactly 4 beats.

sections.title: The Math of Note Values (Fractions)
sections.content: Explain how different musical notes correspond to mathematical fractions. A whole note (1), half note (1/2), and quarter note (1/4). Prerequisite: Basic fraction addition.
sections.example: A 'Pizza Partition' graphic: A whole circle (Whole note) divided into 4 slices (4 Quarter notes). Show that 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1 Measure.

sections.title: Application: Composing with Constraints
sections.content: Combine the time signature and note values to 'fill' a measure. This demonstrates how musicians use arithmetic to ensure the music flows correctly within its structural boundaries.
sections.example: A robot musician trying to fill a 4/4 measure. If the robot plays two half-notes, the measure is full. If it plays one half-note and two quarter-notes, the measure is also perfectly full (2/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1).

sections.title: Summary & The Universal Language
sections.content: Recap that music is essentially applied math in time. Reiterate that measures allow us to organize patterns, making music predictable and beautiful.
sections.example: A final animation showing a scrolling musical staff syncing perfectly with a mathematical number line, proving that rhythm is just counting in disguise.
